nodes.label: main
nodes.desc: Parses flags, builds the kube client, then launches the NGINXController

nodes.label: NewNGINXController
nodes.desc: Wires the store, task queue, template writer and admission server into one controller

nodes.label: Start
nodes.desc: Starts the store, leader election, the nginx process and the select loop that feeds the sync queue

nodes.label: k8sStore.Run
nodes.desc: Runs all informers and keeps a local cache of Ingress, Service, Secret and ConfigMap objects

nodes.label: syncIngress
nodes.desc: Drains queued events, rebuilds the config model and decides between full reload and dynamic update

nodes.label: getConfiguration
nodes.desc: Turns the cached Ingress list into backends, servers and a full ingress.Configuration

nodes.label: OnUpdate
nodes.desc: Renders, tests and writes nginx.conf, then signals nginx to reload workers

nodes.label: generateTemplate
nodes.desc: Fills the TemplateConfig struct and executes the Go template against it

nodes.label: testTemplate
nodes.desc: Runs nginx -t against the generated config in a temp file before committing it

nodes.label: configureDynamically
nodes.desc: POSTs endpoint changes as JSON to the Lua endpoint so upstreams change without a reload

nodes.label: setupLeaderElection
nodes.desc: Contends for a Lease so a single replica publishes Ingress status

nodes.label: HandleAdmission
nodes.desc: Validating webhook handler that reviews Ingress objects before they are stored
